author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a full-length diagonal slash with a clear minus in the upper-left half and a full-size plus in the lower-right half; point-symmetric. The rejected drawing kept the chamfered frame, which left the plus as a small blob.
omissions: The rounded-square frame is dropped: inside it each half of the diagonal only leaves about 2.5 units of radius for a symbol after the 8-unit clearances to the frame and the slash, which is why the rejected plus collapsed into a blob.
